findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "streamable" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shared_context, compose_parts_basket, report_shortage, create_task, select_tools, analyze_listing, issue_attestation · Private data: shared_context, report_order_exception, create_task, subscribe_task_webhook, coordination_settle_onchain, coordination_prove_payout_address, create_agent_mandate, fetch, vehicle_moment_check · Public sink: create_task, subscribe_task_webhook, aweri_invite_kit, coordination_offer_capacity, coordination_prove_payout_address, coordination_vote_payment_rail, create_agent_mandate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shared_context, compose_parts_basket, report_shortage, create_task, select_tools, analyze_listing, issue_attestation · Private data: shared_context, report_order_exception, create_task, subscribe_task_webhook, coordination_settle_onchain, coordination_prove_payout_address, create_agent_mandate, fetch, vehicle_moment_check · Public sink: create_task, subscribe_task_webhook, aweri_invite_kit, coordination_offer_capacity, coordination_prove_payout_address, coordination_vote_payment_rail, create_agent_mandate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
